title.zh: 中醫診斷科：誰在說真話
title.en: TCM diagnostics: who is telling the truth

tagline.zh: 臉說熱，脈說寒；樓梯也會騙人
tagline.en: The face says heat, the pulse says cold; even a staircase can lie

desc.zh: 兩位病人的舌、脈、症互相矛盾；你要判斷誰真誰假，並說得出理由。
desc.en: Two patients whose tongue, pulse and symptoms contradict each other; you decide which is true, and say why.

desc.zh: 血壓、舌診燈、染苔的問題與衛教都是你的；你最先發現病人臉紅不只是上火。
desc.en: Blood pressure, the tongue lamp, questions about stained coats and the education sheet are yours; you are first to notice a red face is not just “heat”.

about.zh: 收藏古醫案。老花眼鏡永遠在頭上，永遠在找。口頭禪：不是誰贏，是誰真。
about.en: Collects old case records. His reading glasses are always on his head and always being searched for. Catchphrase: not who wins, but who is true.

about.zh: 每位病人進門先問三件事：咖啡、橘子、口香糖。染苔騙不過她。
about.en: Asks every patient three things at the door: coffee, oranges, chewing gum. No stained coat gets past her.

role.zh: 六十五歲，退休國文老師

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。認定自己「火氣大」，青草茶喝了一個月。年輕時嚼過檳榔。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Convinced he has “too much fire”; a month on herbal cooling tea. Chewed betel nut when young.

about.zh: 在國外工作，用視訊盯爸爸吃藥。對青草茶一直有意見。
about.en: Works abroad and watches her father take his medicines over video. Has never approved of the cooling tea.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。第一次看中醫。電梯壞了，爬了六層樓梯上來，很緊張。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. First time at a TCM clinic. The lift was broken, so she climbed six floors, nervous.

about.zh: 收到轉診單會回電。最喜歡寫得清楚的轉診單。
about.en: Calls back when a referral arrives. Loves a referral that is written clearly.

plain.zh: 舌象、脈象與症狀指向不同方向；中醫認為此時要判斷哪一邊反映本質、哪一邊是假象。
plain.en: Tongue, pulse and symptoms point different ways; TCM then asks which reflects the real state and which is a false appearance.

plain.zh: 症狀和脈矛盾時，判斷症狀是假象，依脈（與舌）定證；反過來叫舍脈從症。
plain.en: When symptoms and pulse disagree and the symptoms are judged false, the pattern follows the pulse (and tongue); the reverse is “follow the symptoms”.

plain.zh: 中醫認為下焦陽氣虛弱，虛弱的陽氣浮到上面，出現面紅、口瘡等像熱的表現，底子卻是寒。
plain.en: In TCM, when lower yang is weak it may drift upward, producing a red face or mouth sores that look like heat while the root is cold.

plain.zh: 上半身有熱象（口乾口瘡），下半身有寒象（腳冷、便溏、夜尿多）的寒熱錯雜狀態。
plain.en: Heat signs above (dry mouth, sores) with cold signs below (cold feet, loose stools, night urination): mixed cold and heat.

plain.zh: 重按才摸到、一息跳得慢、沒有力氣的脈；中醫認為主裡虛寒。
plain.en: A pulse felt only on deep pressure, slow and without strength; in TCM it means interior deficiency-cold.

plain.zh: 指下像按在琴弦上，端直有力；中醫認為多見於肝鬱、痛證、痰飲。
plain.en: Feels like pressing a taut string, straight and firm; in TCM it appears with liver constraint, pain and phlegm-fluids.

plain.zh: 診脈前讓病人與醫師都安靜下來、呼吸平穩，避免運動與情緒干擾脈象。
plain.en: Letting both patient and examiner settle and breathe evenly before the pulse, so exertion and emotion do not distort it.

plain.zh: 食物或飲料把舌苔染色（咖啡、橘子、口香糖、中藥），會讓舌診判讀失真。
plain.en: Tongue coat coloured by food or drink (coffee, oranges, gum, herbal decoctions), which distorts the reading.

plain.zh: 兩側合谷與太衝四個穴位的合稱；中醫認為配合使用能開鬱、行氣、止痛。
plain.en: The two LI4 and two LR3 points together; in TCM the pair is used to open constraint, move qi and relieve pain.

plain.zh: 中醫認為情緒壓力使肝氣不舒（脹、煩、嘆氣），進而影響脾的運化（食少、便軟）。
plain.en: In TCM, emotional strain stops liver qi flowing (distension, irritability, sighing) and in turn weakens the spleen's digestion (poor appetite, soft stools).

plain.zh: 台灣常見的降火涼茶。中醫認為多屬寒涼，體質虛寒者久服反而傷陽氣。
plain.en: A common Taiwanese “cooling” drink. In TCM most are cold in nature, and prolonged use in a cold constitution damages yang.

plain.zh: 問診的口訣：一問寒熱二問汗，三問頭身四問便，五問飲食六問胸……幫助不漏問。
plain.en: A rhyme that orders the history: cold and heat, sweat, head and body, bowels and urine, food, chest… so nothing is missed.

plain.zh: 切診的另一半：按肌膚、手足、胸腹，看冷熱、軟硬、喜按拒按、有無包塊。
plain.en: The other half of palpation: pressing skin, limbs, chest and abdomen for warmth, firmness, whether pressure relieves or hurts, and any mass.

plain.zh: 提示可能有危險疾病的症狀；出現就先排除，再談調理。
plain.en: A symptom that may signal a dangerous disease; exclude it first, regulate afterwards.

plain.zh: 把病人介紹給另一科評估，寫清楚症狀、位置、時間與病史。
plain.en: Sending the patient to another specialty with symptoms, site, timing and history written clearly.

text.zh: 標準色溫、從正面照、距離固定。淡與紅只差一點光線。
text.en: Standard colour temperature, lit from the front, fixed distance. Pale and red are one bad light apart.

text.zh: 病人靜坐、手臂平放、腕下墊枕。診脈前先平息。
text.en: Patient seated and settled, arm flat, pillow under the wrist. Settle the breath before the pulse.

text.zh: 溫陽的乾薑、肉桂和清熱的黃連、石膏放在同一個櫃子裡，提醒你：方向錯了，藥越好越傷人。
text.en: Warming dried ginger and cinnamon bark share a cabinet with cooling coptis and gypsum, a reminder that the wrong direction hurts more the better the herb.

text.zh: 今天寫著十問歌和一句話：不是誰贏，是誰真。
text.en: Today it carries the ten questions song and one line: not who wins, but who is true.

text.zh: 他留在診間的那一大瓶。「送你們，我不喝了。」
text.en: The big bottle he left behind. “It's yours. I'm done with it.”

text.zh: 中醫認為舌、脈、症矛盾時，要找出哪一邊可以被合理解釋為假象：面紅可以是虛陽上浮，數脈可以是剛爬樓梯，腹脹拒按而脈沉可以是實邪阻滯脈道。判斷標準是「與整體一致」，而不是哪一診比較高級。
text.en: When tongue, pulse and symptoms conflict, TCM looks for the side that can reasonably be explained away: a red face by floating deficient yang, a rapid pulse by a staircase, a deep pulse with a tense abdomen by excess blocking the vessel. The test is consistency with the whole, not which examination ranks higher.

name.en: True cold with false heat, and the reverse

text.zh: 假熱：面紅如妝、口乾卻不想喝或只想熱飲、身熱卻要蓋被、舌淡脈沉弱。假寒：手腳冷卻胸腹灼熱、脈沉有力、舌紅苔黃。中醫認為辨別的關鍵在舌、脈、胸腹的冷熱與二便。
text.en: False heat: a made-up-looking flush, a dry mouth with no wish to drink or only warm drinks, feeling hot yet wanting blankets, pale tongue and deep weak pulse. False cold: cold limbs with a burning chest and abdomen, a deep forceful pulse, red tongue and yellow coat. TCM settles it from tongue, pulse, trunk warmth and the stool and urine.

text.zh: 運動、緊張、剛吃飽、喝酒、咖啡、冷熱、藥物、季節、月經、懷孕都會改變脈。古人主張平旦診脈，今天做不到，至少要平息、靜坐，必要時隔一段時間再診一次。
text.en: Exertion, anxiety, a full stomach, alcohol, coffee, heat and cold, medicines, season, menstruation and pregnancy all alter the pulse. The ancients took it at dawn; today at least settle the breath, sit quietly, and repeat after a while when in doubt.

guide.en: Morning talk by the bronze figure

lines.zh: 連醫師站在銅人旁邊，手在頭上摸來摸去。他在找眼鏡。眼鏡在他頭上。
lines.en: Dr Lien stands by the bronze figure patting the top of his head. He is looking for his glasses. They are on his head.

lines.zh: 今天的主題：舌脈不符。舌和脈吵架的時候，你聽誰的？
lines.en: Today's theme: tongue-pulse mismatch. When tongue and pulse argue, whom do you believe?

lines.zh: 聽比較像真的那個。
lines.en: Whichever looks more like the truth.

lines.zh: 好答案，但要說得出理由。先去標本櫃找兩味溫陽藥來。
lines.en: Good answer, provided you can give the reason. First, fetch two warming herbs from the cabinet.

q.zh: 找出標本櫃裡的乾薑與肉桂
q.en: Find dried ginger and cinnamon bark in the cabinet

post.zh: 等一下有位病人覺得自己上火，青草茶喝了一個月，越喝越累。看到他，先別急著清熱。
post.en: A patient is coming who is sure he has too much fire; a month of herbal cooling tea and he is more tired than ever. When you see him, don't rush to clear heat.

guide.en: Put the ten questions in order

lines.zh: 問診有順序。十問歌背一遍，排給我看。
lines.en: The history has an order. Recite the ten questions song and lay it out.

q.en: The first six of the ten questions

post.zh: 老師，眼鏡在你頭上。
post.en: Doctor, your glasses are on your head.

post.zh: 我知道。我在考它有沒有在。
post.en: I know. I was testing whether they were still there.

note.zh: 臉說熱，舌脈說寒；口瘡要轉診
note.en: Face says heat, tongue and pulse say cold; the sore gets referred

lines.zh: 蔡老師抱著一大瓶青草茶進來，臉頰泛紅，像剛喝過酒。
lines.en: Mr Tsai comes in hugging a big bottle of cooling tea, cheeks flushed as if he had been drinking.

lines.zh: 醫生，我火氣很大。嘴巴破、口乾，青草茶喝一個月了，越喝越沒力。
lines.en: Doctor, I have too much fire. Mouth sores, dry mouth. A month of cooling tea and I only get weaker.

lines.zh: 您怕冷嗎？
lines.en: Do you feel the cold?

lines.zh: 怕啊，腳像冰塊，晚上要起來尿好幾次，大便也不成形。
lines.en: I do. Feet like ice, up several times a night to pass water, and the stools don't hold together.

lines.zh: 聽到了嗎？上面說熱，下面說寒。先看舌。
lines.en: Did you hear that? Heat above, cold below. Tongue first.

post.zh: 舌淡胖、苔白滑。這不是熱的舌頭。
post.en: Pale, swollen, a white slippery coat. That is not a hot tongue.

guide.en: Confirm the tongue under the lamp

lines.zh: 蔡老師，今天早上有沒有喝咖啡、吃橘子、嚼口香糖？
lines.en: Mr Tsai, any coffee, oranges or chewing gum this morning?

lines.zh: 只有青草茶。
lines.en: Only the cooling tea.

lines.zh: 那就不是染苔。你看吧。
lines.en: Then it's not a stained coat. Go ahead and look.

q.zh: 面紅口瘡的病人，舌卻淡胖、苔白厚而潤。舌象在說什麼？
q.en: A patient with a red face and mouth sores, yet a pale swollen tongue with a thick moist white coat. What does it say?

options.zh: 舌淡胖苔白：本質虛寒，面紅是假象
options.en: Pale, swollen, white coat: the root is cold; the flush is false

why.zh: 中醫認為舌反映臟腑氣血的本質；淡胖苔白潤是陽虛有寒濕，和怕冷、便溏、夜尿一致。
why.en: In TCM the tongue reflects the underlying state of organs, qi and blood; pale, swollen and moist-white means yang deficiency with cold-damp, matching the cold feet, loose stools and night urination.

options.en: Red tongue, yellow coat: excess heat

why.zh: 舌是淡的，苔是白的。別讓臉替舌頭回答。
why.en: The tongue is pale and the coat is white. Don't let the face answer for the tongue.

options.en: Crimson with no coat: heat in the nutritive level

why.zh: 絳舌是深紅發暗；這是淡舌，而且苔厚。
why.en: A crimson tongue is dark deep red; this one is pale, with a thick coat.

post.zh: 舌脈不符的時候，是不是舌比較能反映本質？
post.en: When tongue and pulse disagree, does the tongue reflect the root better?

post.zh: 不一定。看哪一診和整體更一致。接著把脈。
post.en: Not necessarily. See which agrees with the whole. Now the pulse.

lines.zh: 蔡老師，手放上來，放鬆。
lines.en: Mr Tsai, rest your hand here and relax.

lines.zh: 輕取摸不到。重按下去才有，一息跳得慢，軟軟的沒什麼力。
lines.en: Nothing on light touch. Only on firm pressure does it appear, slow against your breath, soft and without strength.

q.zh: 重按才得，跳得慢，沒有力。這是什麼脈？
q.en: Found only deep, slow, forceless. Which pulse?

options.en: Deep, slow and forceless: interior deficiency-cold

why.zh: 中醫認為沉主裡、遲主寒、無力主虛。三個字合起來，就是他下半身在說的話。
why.en: In TCM deep means interior, slow means cold and forceless means deficiency. Together they say what his lower body has been saying.

options.en: Surging, rapid, forceful: excess heat

why.zh: 洪脈來盛去衰、輕取就滿指；這條脈要找半天。
why.en: A surging pulse floods the fingers at a touch; this one had to be hunted for.

options.en: Slippery and rapid: phlegm-heat

why.zh: 滑脈圓滑如珠、往來流利，而且他不快。
why.en: A slippery pulse rolls like beads and this one is not fast.

post.zh: 面紅、口瘡說熱；舌、脈、怕冷、便溏、夜尿說寒。你算一算。
post.en: Red face and sores say heat; tongue, pulse, cold feet, loose stools and night urination say cold. Count them.

lines.zh: 蔡老師盯著你，等一個答案。連醫師盯著你，等一個理由。
lines.en: Mr Tsai watches you, waiting for an answer. Dr Lien watches you, waiting for a reason.

q.zh: 舌脈與症狀不符。你怎麼辨證？
q.en: Tongue and pulse disagree with the symptoms. How do you set the pattern?

options.zh: 舍症從脈：辨為陽虛，虛陽上浮
options.en: Follow the pulse: yang deficiency with floating yang

why.zh: 中醫認為久病陽虛，虛陽浮於上，可見面紅口瘡的假熱；舌脈與怕冷便溏一致，整體偏寒，臉是假象。
why.en: In TCM, long-standing yang deficiency lets weak yang drift upward, giving a false heat of flushed face and sores; tongue, pulse, cold feet and loose stools agree on cold, so the face is the false witness.

options.zh: 從症：辨為實熱，清熱瀉火
options.en: Follow the symptoms: excess heat, clear fire

why.zh: 他已經清熱一個月，越清越虛。只看臉不看舌脈，是把假象當本質。
why.en: He has cleared heat for a month and grown weaker. Reading the face and ignoring tongue and pulse mistakes the mask for the man.

options.en: Write both and let the mentor decide

why.zh: 辨證要下判斷並說理由；兩邊都寫等於沒辨。
why.en: A pattern is a judgement with a reason; writing both is writing nothing.

post.zh: 所以我不是上火？
post.en: So I don't have too much fire?

post.zh: 中醫認為是上熱下寒、虛陽上浮。青草茶先停。等一下我們慢慢解釋。
post.en: In TCM terms it is heat above, cold below, with floating deficient yang. Stop the cooling tea for now. We'll explain properly in a moment.

lines.zh: 蔡老師臉這麼紅，血壓先量一下。
lines.en: With a face this red, Mr Tsai, let's check your blood pressure.

lines.zh: 數字偏高。他說早上也覺得頭有點脹。
lines.en: The reading is high. He mentions his head has felt tight since morning.

options.zh: 休息後複測、問頭痛胸悶視力、通知醫師
options.en: Rest and repeat, ask about headache, chest, vision; tell the doctor

why.zh: 第一次偏高要複測；伴隨頭痛、胸悶、視力模糊或神經症狀就是急症。
why.en: A first high reading is repeated; with headache, chest tightness, blurred vision or neurological signs it becomes an emergency.

options.en: It's just “fire”, ignore it

why.zh: 面紅有兩種解釋都要查：中醫的虛陽上浮，西醫的高血壓。
why.en: A red face has two explanations and both get checked: floating yang in TCM, hypertension in Western medicine.

options.en: Prick and bleed to lower it now

why.zh: 護理師不做侵入處置；先評估、先通報。
why.en: Nurses do not perform invasive procedures; assess and report first.

post.zh: 兩種解釋不衝突。中醫調理，西醫檢查，一起處理。
post.en: The two explanations don't clash. TCM regulates, Western medicine investigates; both at once.

lines.zh: 切診不只把脈。按診：肚子冷不冷、喜按還是拒按、有沒有包塊。
lines.en: Palpation is more than the pulse. The abdomen: is it cold, does pressure relieve or hurt, is there a mass?

post.zh: 腹部偏涼，按下去他說舒服，沒有包塊。
post.en: The abdomen is cool, pressure feels good to him, no mass.

post.zh: 喜溫喜按，又是虛寒一票。
post.en: Likes warmth, likes pressure: another vote for deficiency-cold.

lines.zh: 蔡老師，嘴巴破是常換位置，還是一直同一個地方？
lines.en: Mr Tsai, do the sores move around, or is it always the same spot?

lines.zh: 同一個地方，兩個多月了，邊邊硬硬的。我年輕時嚼過檳榔。
lines.en: Same spot, more than two months now, the edge feels hard. I chewed betel nut when I was young.

lines.zh: 連醫師把眼鏡從頭上拿下來，戴上。
lines.en: Dr Lien takes the glasses off his head and puts them on.

q.zh: 同一位置超過兩週不癒、邊緣硬、有檳榔史的口腔潰瘍。你怎麼做？
q.en: A mouth ulcer in one spot for over two weeks, with a hard edge and a betel-nut history. What do you do?

options.zh: 今天轉診口腔外科或耳鼻喉科檢查
options.en: Refer to oral surgery or ENT today

why.zh: 不癒合的口腔潰瘍加檳榔史是口腔癌的紅旗，先排除；中醫調理同時進行。
why.en: A non-healing mouth ulcer with a betel-nut history is a red flag for oral cancer: exclude it first, with TCM care continuing alongside.

options.zh: 先當虛火調理，三個月後再看
options.en: Treat as deficient fire, review in three months

why.zh: 延誤最危險。辨證對了，也不能取代檢查。
why.en: Delay is the real danger. A correct pattern never replaces the examination.

options.en: Tell him to rinse more and sleep earlier

why.zh: 衛教沒有錯，但這個潰瘍需要有人用手電筒和手套去看。
why.en: The advice is fine, but this ulcer needs someone with a torch and gloves.

post.zh: 寫轉診單。證辨得對，是今天第二重要的事；這張單子是第一。
post.en: Write the referral. Getting the pattern right is the second most important thing today; that form is the first.

note.zh: 青草茶停了，理由說清楚了

sub.zh: 爸爸說要停青草茶，是真的嗎？
sub.en: Dad says he has to stop the cooling tea. Is that right?

lines.zh: 醫生，我爸說你叫他停青草茶。他不太信，他覺得自己火很大。
lines.en: Doctor, Dad says you told him to stop the cooling tea. He doesn't quite believe it; he's sure he has too much fire.

lines.zh: 是真的。舌和脈都顯示他底子偏寒，面紅口瘡是虛陽浮上來的假象；青草茶越喝越傷陽氣。
lines.en: It's right. Tongue and pulse both show a cold root; the flushed face and sores are floating deficient yang, a false heat. The cooling tea damages his yang the more he drinks.

lines.zh: 難怪越喝越沒力。
lines.en: No wonder he gets weaker with every bottle.

lines.zh: 還有，口腔外科的轉診單請務必陪他去。這件事比青草茶重要。
lines.en: And please go with him to the oral surgery referral. That matters more than the tea.

lines.zh: 蔡小姐，我是連醫師。早上的辨證我們修正過：你爸爸底子是寒，不是熱，青草茶要停。
lines.en: Ms Tsai, Dr Lien here. We corrected this morning's pattern: your father's root is cold, not heat, and the tea stops.

lines.zh: 掛掉電話，連醫師看著你。
lines.en: He hangs up and looks at you.

lines.zh: 從症辨成實熱那一步，錯在只看臉。病歷我改了，理由你補上。
lines.en: Calling it excess heat from the symptoms went wrong because you read only the face. I've amended the note; you add the reasoning.

guide.en: Follow the pulse, or the symptoms

lines.zh: 舌脈不符有八個字：舍脈從症、舍症從脈。你怎麼決定？
lines.en: For a tongue-pulse mismatch there are two phrases: follow the symptoms, or follow the pulse. How do you choose?

lines.zh: 看哪一邊和整體一致，哪一邊可以被解釋成假象。
lines.en: See which side agrees with the whole, and which can be explained as a false appearance.

lines.zh: 對。脈會被運動、情緒、藥物改變；症會被病人的解讀改變。今天的假象是臉，不是脈。
lines.en: Right. The pulse is changed by exertion, emotion and medicines; symptoms by the patient's own reading of them. Today the false witness was the face, not the pulse.

note.zh: 舌診燈練好了，景岳讀了一段
note.en: Lamp practised, a page of Jingyue read

guide.zh: 練舌診燈的角度與距離

lines.zh: 下午阿芳初診。先把舌診燈的角度和距離練好。光線不對，淡會看成紅。
lines.en: Ms Fang's first visit is this afternoon. Practise the lamp's angle and distance first. With the wrong light, pale reads as red.

post.zh: 還有，記得問咖啡、橘子、口香糖。染苔比燈還會騙人。
post.en: And remember: coffee, oranges, gum. A stained coat lies better than any lamp.

lines.zh: 午餐是護理站的便當。連醫師一邊吃，一邊翻一本舊醫案。
lines.en: Lunch is a boxed meal from the nurses' station. Dr Lien eats with one hand and turns the pages of an old casebook with the other.

lines.zh: 古人也遇過舌脈不符。景岳說脈有真假、症有真假，要「從其真者」。
lines.en: The ancients met tongue-pulse mismatches too. Jingyue wrote that pulse and symptoms can each be true or false, and one follows the true.

lines.zh: 所以不是舌贏還是脈贏，是誰真。
lines.en: So it was never tongue versus pulse. It's who is true.

lines.zh: 吃飯。
lines.en: Eat.

note.zh: 數脈是樓梯，弦脈才是她
note.en: The rapid pulse was the stairs; the wiry one is hers

lines.zh: 阿芳小跑步進來，氣還沒喘勻。
lines.en: Ms Fang half-runs in, still out of breath.

lines.zh: 不好意思，電梯壞了，我爬樓梯上來。第一次看中醫，有點緊張。
lines.en: Sorry, the lift is broken, I took the stairs. First time at a TCM clinic. A bit nervous.

lines.zh: 你下意識伸手想先摸脈。
lines.en: Your hand moves toward her wrist by reflex.

q.zh: 阿芳剛爬完六層樓梯，又緊張。現在把脈，你會？
q.en: Ms Fang has just climbed six floors and is nervous. Taking the pulse now, you…

options.zh: 請她靜坐休息一段時間，先問診再診脈
options.en: Let her sit and settle; history first, pulse later

why.zh: 運動與緊張都會讓脈變數變浮。平息之後的脈才是她的脈。
why.en: Exertion and nerves make a pulse rapid and floating. Only after settling the breath is the pulse hers.

options.en: Take it now and record a rapid pulse

why.zh: 你記錄的是樓梯，不是病人。
why.en: You would be recording the staircase, not the patient.

options.en: Just take the left wrist

why.zh: 換手不會換掉樓梯。
why.en: Changing wrists does not change the stairs.

post.zh: 很好。脈診前要平息：病人靜、醫者靜、環境靜。
post.en: Good. Before the pulse, settle the breath: patient quiet, examiner quiet, room quiet.

lines.zh: 這次來主要是？
lines.en: What brings you in?

lines.zh: 月經前胸脹、很煩躁、常嘆氣。胃口差，大便軟。
lines.en: Before my period my breasts swell, I'm irritable and I sigh a lot. Poor appetite, soft stools.

lines.zh: 情緒不好的時候會更明顯？
lines.en: Worse when you're stressed?

lines.zh: 對，一忙就脹，週末就好一點。
lines.en: Yes. Busy weeks, I bloat; weekends it eases.

lines.zh: 問到這裡，你心裡有一個證了。先別說，用脈去驗證。
lines.en: By now you have a pattern in mind. Don't say it; let the pulse test it.

lines.zh: 她喘勻了。指下如按琴弦，端直而長，不快不慢。
lines.en: Her breathing has evened. Under your fingers: a taut string, straight and long, neither fast nor slow.

q.zh: 休息後的脈：端直如按琴弦。這是？
q.en: After rest: straight and taut like a string. Which pulse?

options.en: Wiry pulse: liver qi constraint

why.zh: 中醫認為肝主疏泄，氣機不暢則脈道拘急如弦；配經前乳脹、嘆氣，肝鬱成立。
why.en: In TCM the liver governs free flow; when qi is constrained the vessel tightens like a string. With premenstrual breast swelling and sighing, liver constraint holds.

options.en: Rapid pulse: heat

why.zh: 數脈剛才有，是樓梯給的。現在不快了。
why.en: The rapid pulse was there earlier, courtesy of the stairs. It is not fast now.

options.en: Slippery: phlegm, food or pregnancy

why.zh: 滑脈圓滑如珠；弦脈是直的、繃的。手感完全不同。
why.en: A slippery pulse rolls like beads; a wiry one is straight and tense. They feel nothing alike.

post.zh: 剛進門那條數脈是樓梯和緊張，不是她的病。這就是為什麼要等。
post.en: The rapid pulse at the door was stairs and nerves, not her illness. That is why we waited.

post.zh: 弦脈加經前乳脹、嘆氣，肝鬱；食少便溏，脾虛。肝鬱脾虛。
post.en: Wiry pulse with premenstrual swelling and sighing: liver constraint. Poor appetite and soft stools: spleen deficiency. Liver constraint with spleen deficiency.

post.zh: 舌呢？
post.en: And the tongue?

post.zh: 舌淡、邊有齒痕、苔薄白，和脾虛一致。這次舌脈是互補，不是打架。
post.en: Pale, tooth-marked edges, thin white coat, consistent with spleen deficiency. This time tongue and pulse complete each other instead of fighting.

lines.zh: 肝鬱常用哪幾個穴？在銅人上指給我看。
lines.en: Which points are commonly used for liver constraint? Show me on the bronze figure.

q.zh: 指出四關與寬胸穴：太衝、合谷、內關
q.en: Point out the four gates and the chest-opening point: LR3, LI4, PC6

post.zh: 太衝配合谷叫四關，開鬱；內關寬胸。合谷、三陰交孕婦禁針，她經前，先問有無懷孕可能。
post.en: LR3 with LI4 are the four gates, opening constraint; PC6 opens the chest. LI4 and SP6 are forbidden in pregnancy, and she is premenstrual, so ask first.

post.zh: 問過了，她說沒有可能。
post.en: Asked. She says there's no chance.

lines.zh: 肝鬱脾虛的代表方是什麼？選出它的組成。
lines.en: The representative formula for liver constraint with spleen deficiency? Pick its herbs.

q.zh: 選出逍遙散的組成（以飲片庫名稱）
q.en: Select the herbs of Xiaoyao San (library names)

post.zh: 疏肝、養血、健脾三組藥在一張方裡。處方我開，你把衛教寫好：情緒、作息、少生冷。
post.en: Soothing the liver, nourishing blood and strengthening the spleen, three groups in one formula. I write the prescription; you write the advice: mood, routine, less raw and cold food.

note.en: Not who wins, but who is true

lines.zh: 今天兩個病人都「不符」。老蔡是臉騙你，阿芳是樓梯騙你。
lines.en: Both patients today were mismatches. Mr Tsai's face lied to you; Ms Fang's staircase lied to you.

lines.zh: 辨證不是找誰對，是找誰真。假的那一診也要寫進病歷，因為下次它還會來。
lines.en: Pattern work is not about who is right but who is true. Write the false witness into the note too; it will be back next time.

lines.zh: 連醫師又開始找眼鏡。在他頭上。
lines.en: Dr Lien starts looking for his glasses again. They are on his head.

guide.en: Check the message at the desk

sub.en: Mr Tsai is booked the day after tomorrow

lines.zh: 蔡老師的轉診收到了，後天排口腔檢查。謝謝你們寫得清楚：位置、時間、檳榔史。
lines.en: Mr Tsai's referral received; oral examination booked for the day after tomorrow. Thanks for writing it clearly: site, duration, betel-nut history.

lines.zh: 謝謝。結果也麻煩讓我們知道，中醫這邊同時調理。
lines.en: Thank you. Please let us know the result; TCM care continues alongside.

lines.zh: 桌角那一大瓶青草茶，貼了張紙條：「送你們，我不喝了。」
lines.en: The big bottle of cooling tea on the corner of the desk carries a note: “It's yours. I'm done with it.”

note.zh: 薑茶可以，先別自己加藥
note.en: Ginger tea is fine; no self-medicating

sub.zh: 爸爸把青草茶倒掉了，晚上可以喝薑茶嗎？
sub.en: Dad poured the tea away. Can he have ginger tea tonight?

lines.zh: 醫生，我爸把青草茶倒掉了。他問晚上可以喝薑茶嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, Dad poured the cooling tea away. He asks whether he can have ginger tea tonight.

lines.zh: 淡薑茶暖一點沒關係。處方等師傅開好再拿，先別自己加藥。後天的檢查最重要。
lines.en: A mild ginger tea for warmth is fine. Wait for the mentor's prescription and don't add anything yourself. The check-up the day after tomorrow matters most.

lines.zh: 你想起那條數脈和那張紅臉。明天的病人，不知道又會派誰來騙你。
lines.en: You think of the rapid pulse and the red face. Tomorrow's patients will send some new liar of their own.

sub.en: Not who wins, but who is true
